### **Company Overview**

We are the better way to work in finance. As private equity’s value creation partner, we sit at the heart of PE where sponsors and CFOs meet. Through financial consulting rooted in data, technology, and AI, we help clients drive value where we support the office of the CFO to drive end-to-end value creation.

If you crave challenging work and are looking to grow, come solve complex issues alongside 1,600+ finance & technology experts in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Backed by premier private equity firms and headquartered in New York with 11 offices around the globe, we are a high-growth, entrepreneurial firm looking for people who want to be part of building something great. Come make your mark.

### **Data & Analytics**

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) team offers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.

We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.

This role can be based in any of our US office locations and is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week. Ideal candidates should be local to the desired location.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

**Accordion Intelligence Lab**

The AI Lab is composed of leading software and AI engineers, designing agentic-AI solutions ahead of the market. Our group builds and operationalizes the AI systems that power Accordion’s consulting capabilities, from agentic architectures and RAG pipelines to evaluation frameworks and production observability.

The Lab works closely with practice leaders to translate research findings into scalable, reliable tools that advance Accordion’s AI-driven value creation work for PE clients and their portfolio companies.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager to join one of Accordion’s new AI-augmented delivery pods—purpose-built teams that combine AI engineering, data science, and product management to transform how PE-backed companies run finance and operations.

In this role, you are the translation layer between client problems and AI system design. You don’t manage Jira tickets, you shape what gets built and why. You’ll run discovery sessions, write tight requirements, and keep sprints moving at a pace that only works if you’re using AI to think faster, write better, and communicate more clearly.

We move at sprint pace, not quarter pace. If you want to own outcomes end-to-end, work directly with PE clients, and build things that matter in finance, this is the role.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Interface with executive clients, garner trust in our services, and fill in your own knowledge gaps in real time.
* Translate ambiguous client problems into clear engineering requirements: PRDs, user stories and functional specs (and do it fast)
* Run client discovery sessions and earn trust quickly, including with CFOs and PE operators
* Own sprint planning and delivery coordination across your pod’s AI engineers and data scientists
* Define success criteria and KPIs for AI-powered features before they are built, not after
* Identify and communicate when an AI system isn’t performing reliably; bridge the gap between technical diagnosis and client-facing communication
* Use AI tools for 50%+ of your written output: requirements, stakeholder communications, research, and sprint planning
* Travel to client site as needed

**Success in the First 6 Months**

* Lead requirements and delivery coordination for at least one end-to-end AI engagement, from discovery through production
* Establish a reputation with your pod and with clients as someone who can run a room, write a tight PRD, and hold a sprint together
* Demonstrate materially faster output because of how you use AI tools, not just that you use them
* Show that you understand AI system behavior well enough to write requirements that aren’t naive about what LLMs can and can’t do

### **What You’ll Bring**

* AI tools are woven into how you work daily, you are materially faster because of it, and you can demonstrate that concretely
* 3–6+ years of PM or delivery management experience in a technical or AI product context
* PE or finance domain experience: FP&A, financial close, ERP systems, or finance transformation programs
* Background in consulting or professional services delivery
* Experience with the commercial dimension of AI products—thinking about adoption, product-market fit, and client value capture, not just delivery
* Demonstrated ability to translate messy, ambiguous business problems into clear engineering requirements
* Experience working directly with engineers on AI/ML or data-intensive products
* Strong written communication skills, you can write a tight PRD, user story, or functional spec (and you can do it fast)
* Comfort with iterative, sprint-based delivery under real time pressure. The world is changing around us, and you’ll drive our products as an agent of change.

This is a high-velocity environment. Sprints are short, client expectations are high, and we don’t slow down between engagements. If you’ve spent time in large enterprise engineering organizations where velocity is constrained by process, this will feel different.

The people who thrive here are those who find the pace energizing, not exhausting. They ship fast because they’ve internalized good judgment—not because they cut corners. They use AI tools to multiply their output, communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders, and course-correct quickly when something isn’t working.

# **Description**

**Summary:**

The AI Product Manager sets product strategy and drives the planning, prioritization, and delivery of AI and data-enabled products that advance Commercial Banking’s AI transformation agenda. This role owns the product strategy and plan for one or more priority AI domains across the commercial client lifecycle (e.g., client service, credit, capital markets, treasury management, and sales) end-to-end – from opportunity assessment and problem definition through business case, build, governance, launch, and measured adoption – partnering closely with engineering, data science, segment risk, compliance, the Commercial Digital product team, and the central Enterprise Data & AI Strategy and Technology Innovation functions. The AI Product Manager is accountable for translating Commercial Banking’s highest-value opportunities into a clear product vision and an executable roadmap, integrated with existing digital channels, that delivers measurable value to customers and colleagues.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the product strategy for assigned Commercial Banking domains (e.g., client service, credit, capital markets, treasury management, and sales): a clear point of view on where AI creates differentiated value for clients and colleagues, which problems to solve first, and what not to pursue.
* Shape a multi-year product vision grounded in client and colleague needs, market and competitive insight, and emerging AI capabilities, and translate it into outcome-based goals (e.g., OKRs) and a prioritized roadmap.
* Assess build, buy, partner, and enterprise-platform reuse options, recommending trade-offs that balance value, speed to market, risk, and cost, and revisit the strategy as results, technology, and business priorities evolve.
* Own end-to-end accountability for the broader product plan, stakeholder messaging, and investment case for assigned AI initiatives – not just the backlog or delivery schedule.
* Build and defend the business case (cost, benefit, PPNR/revenue impact, and risk) required to secure and sustain funding through Huntington’s AI governance and prioritization process.
* Serve as the credible, single point of accountability that segment leaders, technology partners, and executive sponsors can turn to for status, trade-offs, and outcomes.
* Lead with user value: define the colleague or client benefit and the problem to be solved before selecting a capability, model, or vendor.

* Use design thinking and direct engagement with relationship managers, service teams, and customers to validate needs, pain points, and workflow context before scoping solutions.

* Translate validated needs into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria for cross-functional delivery teams.
* Maintain one integrated view across initiatives, segments, data readiness, cross-functional dependencies, and adoption.

* Partner across Commercial, Regional Banking, Payments, Wealth, Insurance, Ops, Risk, and Technology Innovation to align priorities, sequencing, and shared data foundations.

* Maintain a current, transparent roadmap and dependency map that leadership can use to make sequencing and resourcing decisions.

* Partner closely with the Commercial Digital product team to integrate AI capabilities into existing client- and colleague-facing digital channels and platforms, rather than building standalone experiences.
* Align AI product roadmaps with Commercial Digital roadmaps and release plans, jointly planning dependencies, sequencing, and shared capacity so AI features ship as part of the broader digital experience.
* Establish shared intake, prioritization, design standards, and success metrics with Commercial Digital product owners to deliver consistent client and colleague experiences and avoid duplicative investment.
* Define success before launch: establish baselines, target metrics, business outcomes, and attribution methodology in partnership with Finance and Analytics before development begins.

* Ensure measurement goes beyond usage counts to tie adoption to real business outcomes – revenue, banker productivity, customer experience, and risk/quality.

* Report progress against the defined baseline and value case throughout the product lifecycle, adjusting scope when tracking falls short of plan.
* Build within workflows and channels: design and deliver capabilities that meet colleagues and clients where they already work and bank, including existing CRM, servicing, and digital channels, rather than requiring new tools or habits.

* Partner with HR, segment leaders, and change management to build role-specific training, manager reinforcement, and adoption reporting for each launch.

* Continuously gather adoption and quality feedback post-launch and iterate on the product to close usage and value gaps.
* Move from roadmap to execution: convert prioritized concepts into resourced, sequenced delivery plans with clear owners, milestones, and go-live dates.

* Serve as product manager for one or more cross-functional pods (engineers, data scientists, analysts), prioritizing the backlog and ensuring iterative, quality delivery each sprint/quarter.

* Navigate Huntington’s AI governance lifecycle (business value definition, solution assessment, governance/risk review, contracting, and implementation) to keep initiatives on track and in compliance.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Data/Analytics, or a related field
* 7+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of AI, machine learning, or data-driven products from concept through launch.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum delivery model as a product owner or product manager for a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and analysts.

* Demonstrated experience defining product strategy and vision, building and managing a product roadmap, writing business requirements, and defining measurable success criteria (KPIs, OKRs, or equivalent).
* Experience in commercial banking, corporate banking, or another regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with credit, treasury, or relationship-management workflows.

* Experience with generative AI/agentic AI products, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, including Financial Services Cloud), and enterprise data platforms.

* Experience integrating AI or data-driven capabilities into existing digital banking channels and platforms in partnership with digital product, design, and engineering teams
* Familiarity with model risk management, AI governance, and regulatory considerations (e.g., fair lending, data privacy) within banking.
* Track record partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance to move AI initiatives through formal governance and funding approval processes.
* Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting business cases, roadmaps, and value narratives to senior leadership and steering committees.

Our product organization transforms clients’ customer acquisition, retention, and operations through AI and ML. We are seeking a Group AI Product Manager to own digital for one of our largest clients. In this role, you will lead a team designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-native products and agentic workflows that materially improve our client’s economics. You will translate partner objectives, business strategy, and experimentation insights into clear product roadmaps, while working directly with client stakeholders to shape solutions, align on priorities, and guide key product decisions.

We expect this leader to be deeply technical, analytically rigorous, and relentlessly curious. This role will have significant visibility across our client services division. * Translate vision into action: Turn high-level strategy into actionable workstreams, defining sequencing, resourcing, and execution plans in partnership with product team members and cross-functional leads. Create clarity and alignment
* Own outcomes: Own the P&L and business impact of your initiatives, communicating progress, ROI, risks, and opportunities to leadership and client partners, shaping the go-forward for each workstream to ensure it’s positioned to deliver meaningful impact, getting hands-on where necessary to unblock our hardest tasks and hurdles
* Advance the Operating System: Build and deploy agentic workflows across your workstreams in partnership with our central teams. Ensure delivery learnings are turned into reusable capabilities that strengthen the broader system over time
* Develop talent: Manage and develop 2+ product manager(s), creating specific plans, providing hands-on product and analytical support, delegating appropriate work, and instilling a performance-driven environment through clear expectations, regular feedback, and recognition of achievements

This role supports GSK’s manufacturing sites, which make, test, and release our medicines and vaccines safely, compliantly, and at scale. Our ambition is autonomous manufacturing: production processes and support systems (training, workforce planning, quality, maintenance, materials) that plan, adapt, and optimise themselves, freeing people for work that needs human judgement.

As Staff (Director), AI Product Manager for Manufacturing, you will own the manufacturing AI portfolio, shape the vision for autonomous manufacturing, and partner with site and network leadership to back the right use cases and see them delivered, adopted, and scaled.

You will scale existing autonomous programmes, such as training content management and production-floor workforce allocation, and shape what comes next, including autonomous production scheduling. You bring a working understanding of AI, hands-on manufacturing experience, and strong execution and change-management discipline.

## **Why This Role Exists**

Autonomous manufacturing won’t come from isolated pilots. It needs a clear vision, sharp opportunity selection, disciplined delivery, and business teams who own the change. This role brings those together.

In this role, you will:

* Own the manufacturing AI portfolio and roadmap toward autonomous manufacturing.
* Quickly assess which use cases are worth pursuing, backed by evidence.
* Drive delivery from problem framing through deployment, adoption, and value realisation.
* Lead change management so AI solutions are used, trusted, and sustained.
* Act as a trusted partner to manufacturing leadership on AI-driven transformation.

**Responsibilities:**

  
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:  

* Define, with leadership, what autonomous manufacturing means for GSK sites, the target state by area, and a staged, funded roadmap.
* Scale the autonomous training content and workforce optimisation programmes to multi-site outcomes.
* Build the case for autonomous production scheduling and other processes, and move the strongest candidates into delivery.
* Make capabilities built at one site (data foundations, agents, optimisation engines) reusable across the network.
* Quickly assess use cases on value, data readiness, feasibility, compliance, and site appetite, and kill weak ideas early.
* Build finance-ready business cases on throughput, OEE, schedule adherence, right-first-time, labour productivity, training cycle time, and cost avoided.

* Own a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritised opportunities with clear rationale, feeding the Enterprise AI portfolio
* Lead engagements end-to-end with FDE and engineering pods, from scope and success criteria through deployment and hand-over.
* Set milestones, manage dependencies across site, IT/OT, quality, and engineering, and clear blockers from prototype to production.
* Make trade-offs when sponsors compete for capacity, and push back on work that won’t move outcomes.
* Build lasting relationships with site, operations, quality, engineering, and learning leaders, and help shape their agenda.
* Co-own change management, from stakeholder mapping and process redesign to training and adoption tracking, so the floor trusts the new way of working.
* Quickly read each site’s processes, culture, systems, and data, and tailor the approach accordingly.
* Coach Senior AI Product Managers on opportunity selection, value cases, and engagement design.
* Engage VP and site leaders, linking AI progress to manufacturing and patient outcomes clearly and honestly.
* Track value realisation against each engagement’s original case using Enterprise AI’s framework, and refine the framework as you learn.
* Run honest post-mortems and feed lessons into how opportunities are selected, delivered, and scaled.  
    

**Why You?  
****Basic Qualification**  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in technology, product management, business, or life sciences.
* 12+ years of experience across pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other regulated manufacturing, and AI/ML, digital, or product leadership roles.
* Experience working at, or directly supporting, a manufacturing production site.
* Experience with AI technologies such as large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, optimisation and scheduling methods, or the ML lifecycle.
* Experience delivering AI or digital initiatives from problem framing through production deployment.
* Experience leading change management in operational environments.
* Experience building business cases for manufacturing or operations initiatives.
* Experience as a trusted partner to senior business leaders (VP and site-head level), leading through credibility and influence.
* Working knowledge of GxP and data-governance constraints in manufacturing, and how they shape AI deployment and validation.
* Experience in one or more of: production scheduling and optimisation, workforce or shift planning, learning and training systems, MES/ERP, or Industry 4.0 / smart factory programmes is a strong plus.  
    

**Preferred Qualification**  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:  

* Experience leading AI opportunity discovery and use case triage in manufacturing, including prioritising pipelines, making clear go / no-go calls, and shaping a staged roadmap toward autonomous manufacturing.
* Experience building value cases and investment recommendations that withstand finance and senior manufacturing scrutiny, and managing an AI opportunity portfolio.
* Track record of taking AI engagements to production, from defining scope, success criteria, and exit conditions to scaling point solutions into reusable platforms across sites.
* Fluency across LLMs, agentic systems, optimisation, and ML, with the ability to assess manufacturing data readiness (MES, ERP, LMS, historians, rostering systems) and evaluation design.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate product management work, including skills, plugins, and comfort with the command-line interface (CLI).
* Experience navigating GxP, validation, and data-governance requirements when designing AI solutions for manufacturing.
* Experience advising VP and site-head leaders, co-leading change management, and communicating AI impact on manufacturing performance, people, and patients.
* Experience tracking value realisation and adoption, running post-mortems, coaching product teams, and challenging assumptions with evidence.

  

Work Arrangement  
This role follows a hybrid working model based in the United States. You will spend scheduled time on-site to collaborate and engage with stakeholders. Fully remote work is not available for this position.
